name: Barbarian: Body Builder adds 75% of Strength as melee attack power whether Strength or Agility is higher (#12131, #11966)
contract: Body Builder (706481) is the visible talent; its tooltip reads 'Increases your size by $706508s2% and your melee attack power by $s1% of your Strength.' with effect 0 SPELL_AURA_MOD_ATTACK_POWER_OF_STAT_PERCENT (268), amount 75, MiscValue 0 = Strength, and no condition. A level 60 human Barbarian starts with Strength 86 and Agility 133 (player_class_stats class 12 level 60, race 1 adds 0). Low side: learning Body Builder raises melee attack power by 0.75 x 86 = 64.5. High side: Juju Power (16323, SPELL_AURA_MOD_STAT Strength) with its amount set to 200 lifts Strength to 286, above Agility; learning Body Builder must still raise attack power by 0.75 x 286 = 214.5. The removed server rule subtracted the bonus whenever Strength was not lower than Agility, which made the high-side gain 0. Bands are the exact values widened for integer stat and attack power rounding; both sides first pin the Strength and Agility they rely on.
